verdict.rationale: pnpm documents offline installs from the store (`pnpm i --offline`, and a store-only mode that fails if a package isn't cached locally). It also has a CI page covering frozen-lockfile behavior and a content-addressable store that suits caching. Community users report much faster CI installs and smaller caches (15s vs 35s). However, the pack contains no documented cache-restore recipe, such as which store path to cache or how to restore it in CI. missing for 10: a documented CI cache-restore setup (store path / CI cache configuration), independent benchmarks of cached CI installs.
